description:
This thumbnail has a very simple, graphic layout with a warm color palette.

- **Background:** The main background is a pale cream / light beige color.
- **Right side accent:** A large bright orange geometric panel fills the entire right edge of the image. It has a slanted left boundary, creating a diagonal wedge that cuts inward from the top-right toward the lower center-right.
- **Icon:** Near the upper-left corner there is a small orange toolbox icon with a brown handle and dark circular details, matching the hardware-store theme.
- **Main headline text:** Large bold black text appears left of center and reads:
  - **“Mix Any Exterior Paint Color —”**
  - **“In Store”**
  
  The headline is broken into two lines, with the dash at the end of the first line. It is clearly legible and dominates the left-middle area.
- **Brand text at bottom:** Along the lower-left edge, smaller uppercase text reads:
  - **“RIVERSIDE HARDWARE & SUPPLY”**
  
  This text is in a brown/gold color and is also legible.

Overall, the design is sparse and promotional, using cream, orange, black, and brown/gold for a clean hardware-store advertisement look.
